name: Malice Funnel
body:
School abjuration [mind-affecting]; Level classic mesmerist 6, investigator 6, inquisitor 6, legendary mesmerist 7, occultist 6, psychic 7, witch 7; Focus supremacy 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (silk from a funnel-web spider)

EFFECT

Range 60 feet (see text)
Area 60 ft.-radius emanation centered on you
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You expand your mind through the Astral Plane into a web that draws hostile intent inside it. You automatically become aware of the presence of creatures within the spell’s area who mean you harm, or to your surroundings in a way that would harm you in the process. This also includes creatures whose starting attitude to you would be hostile, even if they do not know of you yet, as well as creatures who currently pose no threat, but would harm you if given the chance. The spell can distinguish between creatures willing to hurt you, and those actively trying. This otherwise functions as blindsense. The spell can only detect harmful intent. It cannot foresee accidents or natural disasters. concentrating as a full-round action, you can extend the spell’s radius tenfold. Unless you are on the Astral Plane, the magic aura of malice funnel is hidden away on the part of the Astral Plane conterminous with your location on your current plane, making it detectable only on your person. Creatures who are on or peer into the Astral can detect the spell throughout its area as normal. You also gain a +4 insight bonus on Will saving throws against magic originating from within the spell’s area. On a success, you learn what its effect would have been as though you succeeded on the Spellcraft check.
